items.t: The Sardis plan names Vedder Road as the primary north-south spine of Sardis, connecting its sub-areas including Garrison Crossing.
Canada Education Park lies south of Garrison Crossing along the same Vedder Corridor, per the Sardis plan.

That redevelopment is described by Chilliwack Economic Partners Corporation as including Garrison Crossing within 400 acres total of institutional, commercial and residential development on the former base.

blocks.text: Garrison Crossing: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Sardis land uses were incorporated into city-wide designations in the 2050 Official Community Plan (OCP), Bylaw 2025, No. 5500, which updated the Sardis Neighbourhood Plan adopted October 2020.

City-wide small-scale multi-unit housing (SSMUH) rules require up to 4 units on single-detached or duplex lots over 280 square metres inside the urban growth boundary, affecting about 11,000 Chilliwack properties; exclusions can apply.

blocks.text: Garrison Crossing: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: The former base parade-square saluting base off Caen Avenue was preserved by UFV, with commemorative plaques and metal fixtures shaped as the word "ubique."
UFV's Chilliwack campus address in Canada Education Park is 45190 Caen Avenue, a useful landmark for locating Garrison's south edge.

City curbside collection in Chilliwack includes weekly compostables, bi-weekly recycling and garbage, and monthly glass and flexible plastics; 2026 fees range from $27.15 to $34.80 per month by cart size.
Sardis plan policy prioritizes a neighbourhood park in North Sardis and a corridor plan for Vedder Road, which affect streets north of Garrison as well.
Luckakuck Creek runs through the Sardis plan area near Garrison — check riparian setbacks for lots backing onto it.
Utility rates are billed quarterly by the City, under the Waterworks Regulation Bylaw and Sanitary Sewer System Regulation Bylaw named on its Tax and Utility Rates page.
BC Transit route 51, Vedder, runs downtown to the UFV Chilliwack campus via Vedder Road, serving the Garrison corridor.
BC Transit route 55, Yarrow-Greendale, also starts at the UFV Chilliwack campus and passes the Vedder Road corridor west toward Yarrow.

blocks.text: Garrison Crossing: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check the City's floodplain maps for any lot near Luckakuck Creek or the Vedder River lowlands; the Floodplain Regulation Bylaw 2018, No. 4519 sets flood construction levels in standard-dike areas.

faq.q: What was here before Garrison Crossing?
faq.a: Canadian Forces Base Chilliwack was here before. Chilliwack Economic Partners Corporation states CFB Chilliwack closed its 400-acre site in 1998, and in 2003 the City, Canada Lands Company and partners launched Canada Education Park on 200 acres of the former base, adjacent to the Vedder River, with Garrison Crossing as its residential part.

It is a multi-agency education campus south of Garrison Crossing. Its partners listed include the University of the Fraser Valley (UFV), the Royal Canadian Mounted Police (RCMP) Pacific Region Training Centre, and the Canada Border Services Agency (CBSA), so students and trainees are a regular presence on nearby streets.

Yes, on Vedder Road. The Sardis Neighbourhood Plan states there is a frequent bus line with 15-minute service connecting Sardis to downtown, Garrison Crossing and Canada Education Park to the south along the Vedder Corridor. Confirm the current route and timetable on BC Transit before relying on a specific departure.
School District No. 33 (SD33) lists Vedder Elementary, Vedder Middle and G.W. Use SD33's school locator for the exact address rather than assuming a school from proximity alone.
